<style>
/* âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ
   RESET & FOUNDATION
âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ */
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale}
body{font-family:var(--ff-body);background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);overflow-x:hidden;line-height:1.7}
a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
button{border:none;background:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
ul{list-style:none}

    
/* âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ
   DESIGN TOKENS
âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ */
:root {
  /* Palette */
  --cream: #FDFBF7;
  --cream2: #F7F3ED;
  --cream3: #EFEBE4;
  --white: #FFFFFF;
  --ink: #1A1714;
  --ink2: #3D3832;
  --ink3: #6B6560;
  --ink4: #9A958F;
  --line: #E8E4DE;
  --line2: #D8D3CC;
  --line3: #C8C3BC;

  /* Brand */
  --o: #E8571A;
  --o-d: #CC4A14;
  --o-l: #FFF1EB;
  --o-l2: #FDE8DE;

  /* Accents */
  --sage: #2D8C6E;
  --sage-l: #E8F5F0;
  --amber: #D4930D;
  --amber-l: #FFF8E6;
  --lav: #7C6CBF;
  --lav-l: #F0ECF8;
  --rose: #C75B7A;
  --rose-l: #FBF0F3;
  --slate: #4B6A88;
  --slate-l: #EDF2F7;

  /* Typography */
  --ff-head: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif;
  --ff-body: 'Outfit', -apple-system, sans-serif;
  --ff-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;

  /* Spacing */
  --gutter: clamp(20px, 5vw, 80px);
  --max-w: 1200px;

  /* Radius */
  --r: 6px;
  --r-md: 10px;
  --r-lg: 16px;
  --r-xl: 24px;

  /* Shadows */
  --sh-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  --sh-md: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  --sh-lg: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  --sh-xl: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}

/* âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ
   LAYOUT
âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ */
.wrap { max-width: var(--max-w); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 var(--gutter); }
.section { padding: 100px 0; position: relative; }
.section-white { background: var(--white); }
.section-alt { background: var(--cream2); }
.section-warm { background: var(--cream3); }
.section-dark { background: var(--ink); color: var(--cream); }

/* âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ
   TYPOGRAPHY
âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ */
.eyebrow {
  font-family: var(--ff-mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 2.5px;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--o); font-weight: 500;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
}
.eyebrow::before { content: ''; width: 20px; height: 1px; background: var(--o); }
.h-display {
  font-family: var(--ff-head); font-weight: 300;
  font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 56px); line-height: 1.12;
  color: var(--ink); letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}
.h-display em { font-style: italic; color: var(--o); }
.h-section {
  font-family: var(--ff-head); font-weight: 400;
  font-size: clamp(26px, 3.5vw, 42px); line-height: 1.18;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.h-section em { font-style: italic; color: var(--o); }
.body-lg { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--ink3); max-width: 580px; }
.section-head { margin-bottom: 56px; }

/* âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ
   REVEAL ANIMATION
âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ */
.r { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(28px); transition: all 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); }
.r.in { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
.r1 { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
.r2 { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
.r3 { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
.r4 { transition-delay: 0.4s; }

/* âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ
   DEVELOPMENT PILL (global)
âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ */
.dev-pill {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  background: var(--amber-l); border: 1px solid #E8D48A;
  border-radius: 100px; padding: 6px 16px;
}
.dev-pip { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--amber); animation: pulse-pip 2s infinite; }
@keyframes pulse-pip { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0.4} }
.dev-text { font-family: var(--ff-mono); font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink3); letter-spacing: 0.5px; }

/* âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ
   NAV
âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ */
#nav {
  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 1000;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 var(--gutter); height: 64px;
  background: rgba(253,251,247,0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  transition: all 0.3s;
}
.nav-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.nav-logo-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; }
.nav-logo-icon svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.nav-logo-name { font-family: var(--ff-head); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink); letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.nav-logo-sub { font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink4); margin-left: 2px; }
.nav-center { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.nav-link {
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink3);
  padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: var(--r); transition: all 0.2s;
}
.nav-link:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--cream2); }
.nav-link.active { color: var(--o); font-weight: 500; }
.nav-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.nav-cta {
  padding: 9px 22px; background: var(--o); color: var(--white);
  font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  border: none; cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s; letter-spacing: 0.1px; text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center;
}
.nav-cta:hover { background: var(--o-d); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(232,87,26,0.28); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.btn-ghost {
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink2);
  padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: var(--r-md);
  border: 1px solid var(--line2); transition: all 0.2s;
}
.btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--line3); background: var(--cream2); }
.btn-primary {
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff;
  padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--o); border: 1px solid var(--o);
  transition: all 0.25s;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(232,87,26,0.2);
}
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--o-d); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(232,87,26,0.3); }

/* Mobile nav toggle */
.nav-toggle { display: none; width: 28px; height: 28px; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; cursor: pointer; }
.nav-toggle span { display: block; width: 100%; height: 2px; background: var(--ink2); border-radius: 2px; transition: all .3s; }

/* âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ
   PAGE SYSTEM
âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ */
.page { display: none; }
.page.active { display: block; }

/* âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ
   HERO
âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ */
.hero {
  padding: 140px 0 100px; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(170deg, var(--cream) 0%, var(--o-l) 50%, var(--cream) 100%);
  min-height: 90vh; display: flex; align-items: center;
}
.hero-grid {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0.04;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(var(--ink) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ink) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 80px 80px;
}
.hero-inner {
  position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: var(--max-w);
  margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 var(--gutter);
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 60px; align-items: center;
}
.hero-left { max-width: 580px; }
.hero-pill {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 100px; padding: 6px 16px; margin-bottom: 28px;
  box-shadow: var(--sh-sm);
}
.hero-pill-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--sage); animation: pulse-pip 2s infinite; }
.hero-pill-text { font-family: var(--ff-mono); font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink3); letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
.hero-h1 {
  font-family: var(--ff-head); font-weight: 300;
  font-size: clamp(38px, 5.5vw, 64px); line-height: 1.08;
  color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 24px; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}
.hero-h1 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--o); }
.hero-h1 .serif-thin { font-weight: 300; }
.hero-sub {
  font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--ink3);
  max-width: 460px; margin-bottom: 32px;
}
.hero-btns { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 28px; }
.btn-hero-primary {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff;
  padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--o); border: 1px solid var(--o);
  transition: all .25s;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(232,87,26,0.2);
}
.btn-hero-primary:hover { background: var(--o-d); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(232,87,26,0.28); }
.btn-hero-ghost {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink2);
  padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: var(--r-md);
  background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line2);
  transition: all .2s;
}
.btn-hero-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--line3); background: var(--cream2); }
.credential-strip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.cred-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink3); }
.cred-icon { font-size: 14px; }
.cred-sep { width: 1px; height: 16px; background: var(--line); }

/* Hero visual */
.hero-visual { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.hero-illustration { width: 100%; max-width: 460px; position: relative; }
.hero-img-bg {
  width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1.15;
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 80% at 50% 65%, var(--o-l) 0%, var(--cream2) 100%);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  position: relative;
  display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.hero-robot-photo {
  width: 78%;
  max-width: 310px;
  object-fit: contain;
  object-position: bottom center;
  display: block;
  animation: float-gentle 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 16px 28px rgba(26,23,20,0.10));
  position: relative; z-index: 2;
}
@keyframes float-gentle { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)} 50%{transform:translateY(-10px)} }

/* Hero floating data labels */
.hero-float {
  position: absolute; background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md);
  padding: 10px 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  box-shadow: var(--sh-md);
}
.hero-float-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }
.hero-float-label { font-family: var(--ff-mono); font-size: 9px; color: var(--ink4); letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; }
.hero-float-val { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); }
.hf-1 { top: 10%; left: -8%; animation: float-gentle 3.5s 0s ease-in-out infinite; }
.hf-2 { top: 42%; right: -10%; animation: float-gentle 4s 0.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.hf-3 { bottom: 18%; left: -6%; animation: float-gentle 3.8s 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }

/* âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ
   RECOGNITION BAR (MARQUEE)
âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ */
.recognition-bar {
  background: var(--cream2); border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 14px 0; overflow: hidden;
}
.marquee-track {
  display: flex; gap: 40px; animation: marquee-scroll 30s linear infinite;
  width: max-content;
}
@keyframes marquee-scroll { 0%{transform:translateX(0)} 100%{transform:translateX(-50%)} }
.marquee-item {
  font-family: var(--ff-mono); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink4); white-space: nowrap;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
}
.marquee-dot { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--o); opacity: 0.5; }

/* âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ
   PILLARS (3-col on home)
âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ */
.pillars-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 32px;
}
.pillar-card {
  background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 36px 28px;
  transition: all 0.3s;
}
.pillar-card:hover { border-color: var(--line2); box-shadow: var(--sh-md); transform: translateY(-4px); }
.pillar-icon {
  width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: var(--r-md);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 22px; margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.pillar-icon.health { background: var(--sage-l); color: var(--sage); }
.pillar-icon.emotion { background: var(--lav-l); color: var(--lav); }
.pillar-icon.safety { background: var(--rose-l); color: var(--rose); }
.pillar-title { font-family: var(--ff-head); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 10px; }
.pillar-desc { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--ink3); }

/* âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ

<script>
/* ââ Page Navigation ââ */
function goPage(id) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  const pg = document.getElementById('pg-' + id);
  if (pg) pg.classList.add('active');

  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link').forEach(l => {

}

document.querySelectorAll('.r').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
